label: Jesus walking through Europe knocking on doors
description: Jesus seen moving through European villages knocking at houses whose hinges are broken off and whose roofs are missing shingles, with the people in lederhosen and the flowers turning toward him, and the time said three times to be late. Given 18 and 19 November 2025 in two uploads of the same sequence.

label: Build-a-baby, and children with a disconnect in their eyes
description: Children seen with a disconnect in their eyes, in material he introduces as a build-a-baby practice coming. Given 16 November 2025.
aliases: these children looked like in their eyes

label: A drought on the land that is spiritual rather than natural
description: A drought seen over the land which he says is not a natural drought but a spiritual one. Given 14 November 2025.

label: Go back to a pioneer work, the core values are lost
description: America told to go back to a pioneer work like Little House on the Prairie, having lost its foundation and key core values, with time said to be short. Given 14 November 2025.
